title.narrative: Access to Clean Energy Investment Program

description.narrative: The proposed Asian Development (ADB) assistance will contribute to Pakistan's national goal of enhanced energy security. The program will be implemented over a period of 5-10 years and will support the provincial governments of Khyber PakhtunKhwa (KPK) and Punjab (GoKPK and GoPb) to achieve increased access to sustainable and more reliable electricity services for vulnerable communities. This outcome will be achieved through four components: (i) expanding access to renewable energy, notably micro-hydropower (MHP) plants in rural off-grid areas of KPK, and decentralized solar plants for education and primary health care facilities (PHFs) in KPK and Punjab; (ii) providing women and girls with increased opportunities to obtain energy services and benefits; (iii) enhancing institutional capacity to foster sustainability; and (iv) promoting public sector energy efficiency in Punjab.

description.narrative: Access to sustainable and more reliable electricity services increased, particularly for vulnerable communities in KPP and Punjab

By 2024, access to electricity is provided to an additional 240,000 households and 2.6 million students in unelectrified and poorly electrified areas. (DLI 1) (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Completed Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:

In previously electrified areas, the number of targeted schools and PHFs affected by load shedding is reduced to zero by 2021. (2016 baseline: 13,000 schools, 1,900 PHFs) Progress/Status: Completed Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Institutional capacity to foster sustainability enhanced. Indicator: By 2024, 100% of identified energy and finance department staff of both provinces are trained on technical issues, gender, project management, financial management, contract management, energy audit, environmental and social management, and climate risk management. (2016 baseline: 0 staff trained) Progress/Status: Completed Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:

Output: Opportunity for women and girls to obtain energy services and benefits increased. Indicator: By 2024, 3,000 women are trained to equip them in using energy benefits. (2016 baseline: 0 women trained) Progress/Status: Ongoing. Data Source: PPR of PEDO Actual value:

Output: Opportunity for women and girls to obtain energy services and benefits increased. Indicator: By 2024, 500 PHFs used by women for delivery or antenatal care are equipped with solar plants. (2016 baseline: 0 facilities equipped) Progress/Status: Ongoing. Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:

Output: Opportunity for women and girls to obtain energy services and benefits increased. Indicator: By 2024, girls' schools account for at least 30% of schools with solar plant installed. (DLI 4) (2016 baseline: %, no school) Progress/Status: Ongoing. Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:

Output: Opportunity for women and girls to obtain energy services and benefits increased. Indicator: By 2024, households headed by women account for at least 7% of target households that are newly connected to electricity. (DLI 5) (2016 baseline: 0 households connected) Progress/Status: Ongoing. Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:

Output: Public sector energy efficiency promoted in Punjab. Indicator: By 2024, energy audits are conducted on 100% of identified public sector buildings and a model net-zero energy building is constructed. (DLI 8) (2016 baseline: no energy audits, no net-zero energy building) Progress/Status: Completed Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:

Output: Renewable energy-based power plants installed. Indicator: By 2024, at least 26,587 sites have renewable energy-based power plants installed. (DLI 3) (2016 baseline: 0 installed) Progress/Status: Ongoing. Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:

Output: Renewable energy-based power plants installed. Indicator: By 2024, power generation capacity from clean energy sources is increased by 182 MW. (DLI 2) (2016 baseline: 0 MW) Progress/Status: Ongoing. Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Actual value:

Output: Institutional capacity to foster sustainability enhanced. Indicator: Annual performance monitoring reports are produced on all indicators and PAP actions based on the internet-based PPMS starting in 2017. (DLI 7) (2016 baseline: no PPMS) Progress/Status: Ongoing. Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: Institutional capacity to foster sustainability enhanced. Indicator: By 2024, PEDO and EDP's governance, financial management, and procurement functions are improved. (DLI 6) (2016 baseline: No dedicated procurement unit or internal audit function) Progress/Status: Completed Data Source: PPR of PEDO and EDP Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2024 Target value: Y
